resources.string: Waiting for %1$s. Click Allow on the laptop if it shows the code %2$s.
Couldn\'t reach the laptop. Check that ScreenLink is open on it, both devices are on the same Wi-Fi, and the laptop allows ScreenLink through its firewall.
This laptop\'s identity has changed, so ScreenLink stopped for your safety. If you reinstalled ScreenLink on the laptop, forget it here and pair again.
The laptop runs a different version of ScreenLink. Update both apps.
ScreenLink was closed on the laptop.
Connect to a laptop first (Laptop tab).
Check that the laptop shows exactly this code. Only continue if it matches.
No laptops found. Open ScreenLink on your laptop, or enter its address below.
The address is shown in ScreenLink on the laptop.
Your phone and laptop must be on the same Wi-Fi network. Everything is encrypted and stays on your network.
Your screen is being shown on the laptop.
Casting stopped because of a problem. Try again.
Android asks for your permission each time. Apps that protect their content (banking, some video apps) appear black. Sound stays on the phone.
Type here with your phone\'s keyboard and the text appears on the laptop wherever its cursor is.
Tap a modifier, then a key or letter, for shortcuts like Ctrl+S.
Your screen is visible on the laptop, and the laptop can control this phone.
Let the laptop control this phone

When this is on and you are casting, the paired laptop can tap, swipe, type into text fields and press Back, Home and Recents on this phone, like you would. It works only while casting to your paired laptop, and you can turn it off here at any time. ScreenLink uses Android\'s accessibility service for this; it reads nothing except the text field you are typing into, and sends nothing back.
Accessibility service: off. Turn on \"ScreenLink control\" in accessibility settings.
If Android says the setting is restricted (Android 13+, apps installed from a file): open Settings → Apps → ScreenLink → ⋮ menu → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
You are sharing a single app. Choose \"Entire screen\" when you start casting to control the phone.
The laptop can control this phone now. Click on the phone screen in the laptop window.

Lets your paired laptop tap, swipe, type into the focused text field and press Back, Home and Recents on this phone, only while you are casting to it with ScreenLink and have allowed control in the app. It reads no screen content except the text field you are typing into.
Everything on your screen is visible on the laptop.
